## Summary

**Delivered candidate: `candidate_01`** (derived from seed via one targeted revision).

**Review performed:** Compared the seed BIM against all four elevations (North/South/East/West) and both plans (1F/2F) using `view_elevation_candidate`, pixel-level measurement (`pixel_profile`), and `overlay_candidate`/`check_source_space_relation`.

**Discrepancy found and corrected:**
- **F1:W4** (south wall, small window between the SW door and the standard windows) was modeled with the same height/position as the other 1.6m windows (sill 1.007m, head 2.605m). Pixel measurement on `South_view.png` — calibrated and cross-validated against `F1:D8`, `F1:W5`, `F1:W6` which matched the seed almost exactly (confirming the calibration) — showed this window is actually much smaller and set higher: sill ≈1.509m, head ≈2.098m, height ≈0.59m. Width/x-position were already correct and untouched. Recorded as `claim_0001` (image_axis measurement) and applied via `update_window`.

**Confirmed correct (no changes needed):**
- North/South F1 and F2 standard window families (sill/head/height) match dimension chains exactly (1007/2605/1598mm on F1; 1012/2801/1789mm on F2).
- West door `F1:D7` width/position/height (2.10m) and East/West `F2:W7/W8` window family match the drawings.
- Plan partition topology for both floors: `overlay_candidate` projections of the source boundaries/openings align closely with the visible walls, doors and windows in `1f_view.png` and `2f_view.png`.
- Sampled `check_source_space_relation` checks (corridor continuity, north_a/b separation, south_a/b separation) all matched expectations with no conflicts.

**Preserved assumptions/unresolved items (unchanged, still valid):**
- Interior doors (F1/F2 D1–D6) assumed 2.1m — not visible in any elevation (interior partitions aren't elevated).
- West porch recess and South SW notch simplified to flush walls with single doors.
- No stair/vertical circulation modeled (not shown in supplied drawings).
- Furniture not modeled (partitions/openings only).
- Door swing states unknown.

**Limitations honestly reported:**
- Only 3 sampled space-relation observations were checked (not exhaustive), though they cover the main partition-topology risk points and are corroborated by the strong overlay alignment across both floors.
- Height coverage remains "unchecked" for most openings in `check_openings`'s strict image-linkage sense, even though North/East/West/most-of-South windows were visually/numerically cross-checked against their elevations in this session (only the one corrected opening carries a formal claim binding).
- Calibration for `overlay_candidate`/`check_source_space_relation` was caller-supplied (visually estimated wall extents) and flagged by the tool as having ~1.4% cross-axis disagreement — sufficient for topology sampling but not a certified survey-grade calibration.
- room_use_review: all 14 spaces remain unrecorded (no room-type/use assignment was in scope for this geometry-fidelity review).

Finished via `finish_bim(candidate_01)`.
